# spacelab-sensors

Coverage constraints: continuous scalar predicates over (satellite, cell, sensor).

Part of [spacelab](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab), astrodynamics in Rust organised around independent
verification: every published number is checked against a lineage that did not come
from the project. This crate is verified in [§4 Estimation, control, sensors, coverage & constellations](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab/blob/main/docs/verification.md#4--estimation-control-sensors-coverage--constellations) (13 rows).

- API documentation: <https://docs.rs/spacelab-sensors>
- Homepage: <https://spacedatalab.org>
